headline: New launches boosting growth

highlights: Revenue growth of 20.8% YoY was on the back of last year’s favourable base (operations impacted to supply disruption at a CMO and GST impact).
Management is confident of delivering double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA margin of ~34% in FY27.
Healthy revenue growth aided by favourable base Revenue grew 20.8% YoY (+26.1% QoQ) to INR 11.8bn (I-Sec: INR 10.7bn).
Gross margin contracted 127bps YoY (-261bps QoQ) to 62.4%, despite cost pressure.
valuation: The next important launch is Blenrep, an ADC for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma expected in Q3FY27.
Valuation and risks Benefit of a low base due to supply-led issues in the past, traction in existing mature brands and new launches helped GSK to report strong revenue in H1FY27.
The stock currently trades at attractive valuations of 32.5x FY28E earnings and 22.8x EV/EBITDA.
watch: Valuation and risks Benefit of a low base due to supply-led issues in the past, traction in existing mature brands and new launches helped GSK to report strong revenue in H1FY27.
Key downside risks: More products under price control; and delay in launching new products.
